text:
incident-bot: Pager: billing/metering — emitter heartbeat noisy; token aggregation divergence vs shadow detected. Severity: P2. Possible duplicate emissions & delayed windowing. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/meetings/metering-heartbeat

elaine: ack — oncall here. pulling dashboards and logs now.

sam: seeing a spike on emitter-shard-3 02:17-02:23 UTC, consumer lag + replay bursts. sample query: `SELECT emitter_shard, COUNT(*) FROM token_events WHERE ts >= now()-interval '1 hour' GROUP BY emitter_shard;`

mike: customer-impact check: some orgs got overage flags (email notifications). no charges applied yet, finance notified.

sara: confirmed ~12 customers got alerts, 2 opened tickets. holding outbound comms until we confirm scope.

sam: hypothesis: intermittent kafka consumer lag + retry loop caused duplicate replays into aggregator windowing -> double-counts in billing window. current delta estimate ~ +2–4% tokens for the last hour on affected shards.

elaine: mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter retry loop on shard-3 2) route shard-3 to failover aggregator 3) enable aggregator dedupe rule for recent message ids. I'll run steps now.

sam: running commands now:
```
./ops/pause-emitter --shard=3 --dry-run=false
./ops/route-traffic --from=emitter-shard-3 --to=agg-failover-2
```

incident-bot: Created incident channel #inc-1738889991; incident lead: elaine. Runbook: metering/replay-dedup.md

mike: finance: @ana please hold invoice generation for orgs with overage flags until reconciliation. cc: billing-alerts list.

ana: (finance) received. Will hold invoice runs for impacted orgs and mark them pending.

sara: customer update draft: "We detected erroneous overage notifications caused by a metering emitter replay. We are not charging customers and are reverting any incorrect counts. We'll follow up once counts are reconciled." OK to send after backfill plan is set? :thumbsup:

elaine: rolling mitigation now — ETA ~8m. I'll push status updates.

sam: pause succeeded, routing swapped. duplicate detection hitting. quick log sample: 
```
[2026-03-18T02:20:12Z] emitter-shard-3 requeued msg id=abc123 duplicate=true
[2026-03-18T02:21:05Z] aggregator-dedupe hit msg id=abc123
[2026-03-18T02:22:01Z] emitter-shard-3 retry-loop count=4 lag_ms=18000
```

mike: rough numbers from sampling: ~2.3M tokens over-counted across the hour window. If we backfill and deduct duplicates, bill impact negligible but customer-facing alerts need clearing.

elaine: action: schedule backfill job to recompute aggregates for shard-3 window (02:00-03:00 UTC) and push corrections to billing shadow. I'll create a backfill ticket and handoff to billing for verification after run.

sara: once backfill job is scheduled, I'll send the customer hold message and link to status page.

sam: short-term ops follow-ups: add a replay-rate metric and alert if replay_rate > 0.5% of windowed tokens; increase emitter retry backoff, add idempotency token retention to aggregator for 10m sliding window.

elaine: handing off to night oncall John for 07:00 UTC watch — mitigation is in place and we're monitoring. John, see the runbook and backfill ticket #BF-1738889991. Please verify metrics converge and confirm customer comms when ready.

john: ack — will pick up at 07:00 UTC, watching dashboards.

sam: incident note: mitigated -> monitoring. start_ts=1738889991. set status to MONITORING; will produce postmortem template.

incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigated -> monitoring. start=1738889991, status_change=1738890600.

elaine: thanks team — postmortem owners: sam (tech), mike (billing), sara (customer). I'll draft initial timeline and action items."
